fields.narrative_intro: *A bumbling person and an imperious person discuss Amazon blocking Meta's Muse AI agent from shopping on amazon.com at a courthouse.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
BUMBLING PERSON: "Meta's new Muse AI agent is today's defendant."
IMPERIOUS PERSON: "Its crime?"
fields.panel2:
[build]
BUMBLING PERSON: "Amazon blocked it from shopping on amazon.com."
IMPERIOUS PERSON: "Then it has no standing."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
BUMBLING PERSON: "The courthouse AI legal assistant is also on trial."
IMPERIOUS PERSON: "For giving Muse legal standing?"
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Muse and the legal assistant stare silently; an empty shopping cart rolls into the witness box and raises one handle.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
BUMBLING PERSON: "Muse has no standing."
IMPERIOUS PERSON: "The cart has wheels. That's apparently enough."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: The empty cart rolls to the judge's bench; Muse and the legal assistant chase it, carrying briefcases.]

narrative_summary: The courthouse treats Amazon's block of Meta's Muse as a standing dispute, making an empty cart the only credible litigant.
rationale: Candidate 1 turns the specific shopping block into a clean, escalating legal pun: Muse has no “standing,” while the empty cart has wheels and therefore qualifies. Its final chase visual pays off the premise without merely repeating the news story.
story_title: Amazon blocks Meta’s new Muse AI agent from shopping on amazon.com
place: at a courthouse where the AI legal assistant is also on trial
hat_pair: foam birthday cake hat with lit candles and tiny plastic sprinkles raining off the sides
foam emergency brake handle worn as a hat with a red warning tag dangling from the brim
